name: Precursor: Firefly
source:
Firefly, a retired magical girl turned private investigator, receives an encrypted email revealing that a missing scientist was actually murdered by the newly appointed Head Girl, Refulgence. Weakened by age, and suspended from active duty, Firefly recruits a team of retired magical girls to bring Refulgence to justice.

[From [url=https://izzycatz.itch.io/precursorfirefly]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
萤火虫是一位退休的魔法女孩，后来成为私家侦探，她收到一封加密电子邮件，显示一名失踪的科学家实际上是被新任命的女校长Refulgence谋杀的。由于年事已高，萤火虫被停职，她招募了一支由退休魔法少女组成的队伍，将光辉绳之以法。

[来自[url=https://izzycatz.itch.io/precursorfirefly]itch.io[/url]]
